connector.name: Entity Enricher
connector.registryDescription: Multi-LLM entity enrichment: schemas, single/batch enrichment, fusion, model benchmarks.
connector.summary: Hosted at entityenricher.ai over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.entityenricher, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional. OAuth 2.1 is the primary auth: clients implementing the standard MCP auth spec (claude.ai, Claude Code, Cursor) omit this header and authorize interactively via browser consent. Use an Entity Enricher API key (ent_..., created under Settings -> API Keys) only for static-config or headless clients.
